_about: Wording for every reminder (F65, D89). Edit freely: a test renders every variant with sample data and fails on a missing placeholder, a subject over 50 characters or a push over 120. Placeholders: {{.Name}} (may be empty), {{.Streak}}, {{.Missed}}, {{.Task.Label}}, {{.Task.Title}}, {{.Task.Mins}}, {{.Week.Days}}, {{.Week.Questions}}. Each kind has one to three variants; "to" says where the button goes (task, the default; today; review) and "card": false hides the task card; the same one never goes to a student twice in a row. Plain words, no guilt, no exclamation marks.

body: It's been twelve days, so we'll stop reminding you. Nothing is lost: your plan, progress and mistakes are all where you left them.
Practise once, whenever you're ready, and reminders start again by themselves.
